name: kwin-mcp-warden
description: kwin-mcp with a warden: MCP server + skill for Linux KDE Plasma 6 Wayland GUI automation where Claude asks first through a consent card, access is granted one window at a time, and a stop key (Meta+Alt+Esc) ends it at once. Provides 31 MCP tools (sessions, apps, screen capture, AT-SPI2 elements with refs, windows and virtual desktops, pointer, keyboard, touch, clipboard, D-Bus and Wayland escape hatches) plus the kwin-desktop-automation skill that guides session-mode selection, observation/action sequencing, and platform pitfalls.
